dialogue.origin: （おはようございます本日は宜しくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Good morning. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.origin: おはようございます。相談者役をさせていただきます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good morning. I will be playing the role of the client. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: （お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.content: (We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: 了解です
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: おはようございます、相談員です本日はご相談にきていただきありがとうございますはじめに年齢、性別をお聞かせいただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Good morning, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: はい５１歳　女性
dialogue.content: Yes, 51 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます今日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 高２の息子のことですが…初めてのSNS相談で、緊張します
dialogue.content: It's about my son, who's a sophomore in high school... This is my first time using an online chat for counseling, so I'm a bit nervous.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんの事でお悩みなのですね初めてということですが、どうぞリラックスして何でもお話してくださいね
dialogue.content: So you're concerned about your son. I understand it's your first time, but please relax and feel free to talk about anything.

dialogue.origin: そう言ってもらえると助かります
dialogue.content: It helps to hear you say that.

dialogue.origin: では、息子さんのどのようなことのご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, what specific concerns do you have about your son?

dialogue.origin: 高校生になってから、学校を休む頻度が多くなったんです
dialogue.content: Since he started high school, he's been missing school more frequently.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは心配になりますよね
dialogue.content: I see, that must be worrying for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 現在高校2年生ということですが、お休みされるようになったのはいつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned he's a sophomore now. Around when did he start missing school?

dialogue.origin: １年の秋くらいからかなって感じです
dialogue.content: I think it started around the fall of his freshman year.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、では一年弱位前からということですね。お休みされ始めたときのきっかけや状況はどのような感じだったか覚えていることはありますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, so it's been a little less than a year. Do you recall any triggers or circumstances around when the absences began?

dialogue.origin: きっかけ…胃が気持ち悪いとか…だるいとか微熱とか…です
dialogue.content: A trigger... He would say his stomach felt sick... or that he felt sluggish, or had a low-grade fever... things like that.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、体調がすぐれないのは息子さんもしんどいし、ご家族もお辛かったですね
dialogue.content: I understand. It must be tough for your son not to feel well, and it must have been hard on your family too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです早退で学校から迎えにくるように昼前に電話が時々くるので、困るんです
dialogue.content: Yes. I sometimes get calls from the school before noon asking me to pick him up because he's leaving early, which is difficult for me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、学校に行かれてから体調を崩されるんですねそれは心配ですよね現在もそういった症状は続いている状態でしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, so he gets sick after he's already at school. That must be very concerning. Are these symptoms still continuing?

dialogue.origin: はい最近も早退とか…丸一日休んだりとか微熱を主張してコロナだから休むとか…
dialogue.content: Yes. Recently he's still been leaving early... or taking the whole day off, or claiming he has a low-grade fever and needs to stay home because of COVID...

dialogue.origin: ええ、現在はそういった状況なのですね息子さんも長く症状が続くとお辛いですね今は一ヶ月に一日学校にいられる日はどのくらいありますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the current situation. It must be difficult for your son to have these symptoms for so long. Right now, about how many days a month is he able to attend school?

dialogue.origin: あっそこまでたくさん休んでるわけではなく…月に３回くらい？とかでも、春の花粉症の時期は、もう少し多いかもです
dialogue.content: Oh, he's not absent that much... maybe about three times a month? But it might be a little more during the spring hay fever season.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、やはりお母様もご心配が続きますと、心身ともにお疲れもあると思います
dialogue.content: I see. When you're constantly worried like this, I imagine it must be exhausting for you, both mentally and physically.

dialogue.origin: 病院を受診されたり治療を受けたりはされていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Has he seen a doctor or received any treatment?

dialogue.origin: 私は、迎えにいくのが負担なんです…息子は、自宅ではたっぷり寝たり…わりとうちでは元気そうなんで…それくらいなら、授業くらい我慢して受けたらって言うんですけどね…
dialogue.content: For me, going to pick him up is a burden... At home he sleeps a lot and seems fairly energetic... so I tell him that if it’s just that, he should try to tough it out and attend class...

dialogue.origin: 病院行っても無駄に薬買わされて、メリット感じないですね
dialogue.content: Even if we go to the doctor, we just end up buying medicine we don't need. I don't see the benefit.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、、突然のお迎えは大変ですよね
dialogue.content: I see... It must be very difficult to have to pick him up so suddenly.

dialogue.origin: 病院の治療もあまり効果はないとお感じなのですね
dialogue.content: And you feel that the treatment from the doctor hasn't been very effective.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですだから、１時間とか待ってもらうように保健の先生に頼むですけど…自転車で帰ってほしい…
dialogue.content: That's right. So I ask the school nurse to have him wait for an hour or so... I wish he would just ride his bike home...

dialogue.origin: コロナだから、無駄にＰＣＲ検査、２回も受けさせられました…
dialogue.content: Because of COVID, he was made to take PCR tests unnecessarily, twice...

dialogue.origin: ↑コロナ禍だからという意味で、息子はコロナではありません
dialogue.content: I mean that it was because of the pandemic; my son does not have COVID.

dialogue.origin: はい、このご時世微熱や風邪症状だと検査を学校から求められるのですねそれは大変なご負担ですね
dialogue.content: Yes, in this day and age, I understand the school requires a test if there's a low-grade fever or cold-like symptoms. That must be a significant burden.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです病院行くのも時間がかかるので…それに、息子の鼻の粘膜も傷つきそうで…
dialogue.content: It is. It takes time to go to the hospital... and I'm worried it might damage the lining of my son's nose...

dialogue.origin: ええ、コロナの可能性も低い中の検査には疑問を感じておられるのですね。息子さんは家ではわりとお元気に過ごしているようとおっしゃっていますが、学校での様子は先生からどのようにお聞きになっていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, you have doubts about the testing when the chance of him having COVID is low. You mentioned your son seems quite energetic at home, but what have you heard from his teachers about how he is at school?

dialogue.origin: はい日本人って心配性な人、多いですよね…担任の先生は、社会の先生で、ほとんど理系の息子には関わってないんです
dialogue.content: Yes. There are a lot of worriers in Japan, aren't there... His homeroom teacher is a social studies teacher, and since my son is in the science track, the teacher is hardly involved with him.

dialogue.origin: 保護者会では、先生から逆に聞かれました息子の様子を
dialogue.content: At the parent-teacher conference, the teacher actually asked me about how my son was doing.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、学校は万が一の対応を気にしているということなのですねまた担任の先生も息子さんと関わりが少なくて、息子さんのことをあまりわかっていらっしゃらないということですねそれはお母様がお一人で大変な様子がよくわかります
dialogue.content: I see, so the school is concerned about covering all possibilities, just in case. And his homeroom teacher has little interaction with your son and doesn't seem to know him very well. I can see how difficult this must be for you, having to handle it all alone.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんの今の状況を担任の先生の他にどなたかお話したり、ご相談したり出来る機会というのはございますか？
dialogue.content: Besides the homeroom teacher, is there anyone else you can talk to or consult with about your son's current situation?

dialogue.origin: そう言ってもらえると助かります学校が万が一の対応するのは、ケースバイケースだと思うんです私は入学時に、花粉症などのことを伝えてるので…今も担任の先生や保健の先生に、息子のタイプを伝えてますが…他には、話してみたい人はいないですね
dialogue.content: It helps to hear you say that. I think the school's 'just in case' response should be on a case-by-case basis. When he enrolled, I told them about things like his hay fever... And I'm still telling his homeroom teacher and the school nurse about the type of person my son is... but other than that, there's no one else I'd like to talk to.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、お母様は学校に息子さんの状態を伝えるようにされたり、できることはやっておられるといった状況なのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So it sounds like you're doing what you can, such as trying to communicate your son's condition to the school.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんが何か学校や友達の関係などで心配事があったりなど何かお聞きになっていることなどはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you heard anything from your son about any worries he might have regarding school or his friendships?

dialogue.origin: はいなるべく自分ができることは全てやってます体温計って種類とかメーカーで、かなり誤差あるので、微熱の件は最近解決できました
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm trying to do everything I can. We recently solved the low-grade fever issue, as it turns out there's a significant margin of error depending on the type and manufacturer of the thermometer.

dialogue.origin: 体温計の誤差からくる微熱だったのですねまずは一つ解決して良かったです
dialogue.content: So the low-grade fever was due to thermometer discrepancies. I’m glad one issue has been resolved.

dialogue.origin: 息子は、高校生男子にしては、私にいろいろと話すタイプなので、交友関係は問題ないようです
dialogue.content: For a high school boy, my son is the type to talk to me about a lot of things, so it seems there are no problems with his friendships.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんとコミュニケーションも取られていて、良いご関係をお築きなのですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you communicate with your son and have built a good relationship.

dialogue.origin: 体温計シチズンは、0.3℃も高いで、テルモが正確だとわかりました
dialogue.content: We found that the Citizen thermometer reads as much as 0.3°C higher, and that the Terumo one is accurate.

dialogue.origin: ええ、なるほどとても参考になりますそんなに違いがあるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, that's very helpful to know. I didn't realize there could be such a difference.

dialogue.origin: 息子とは、中学３年から、頻繁に言い合いになりますけどね💦
dialogue.content: Although, my son and I have been arguing frequently since his third year of junior high. 💦

dialogue.origin: シチズンは、ドラッグストアのポイントでもらったので…こういうのは、きちんと購入すべきでしたね
dialogue.content: We got the Citizen one with points from a drugstore... I guess we should have bought a proper one.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、思春期まっただ中というところもあるかもしれませんが、息子さんはご自分の意見をきちんとお伝えできる状況なのですね
dialogue.content: I see. It might be partly because he's in the middle of his teenage years, but it sounds like your son is able to express his own opinions clearly.

dialogue.origin: そうですね自己主張できる子って、いいことですね
dialogue.content: That's true. It's a good thing for a child to be able to assert themselves.

dialogue.origin: はい、考えや意見が言えないとどうしてほしいかも伝わりにくいですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, if they can't state their thoughts and opinions, it's hard for others to know what they want.

dialogue.origin: お母様としては今は学校の対応に負担をお感じになっていて、もう少し息子さんの様子や状況を理解してもらいたいといったお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, as a mother, would you say that right now you feel burdened by the school's response, and you wish they would understand your son's condition and situation a little better?

dialogue.origin: はい、特進コースなので、受験や進級に関わるので、自己管理して、自分の人生に高校生でもある程度、責任もってもらわないと…
dialogue.content: Yes. He's in a special advanced course, so it affects his university entrance exams and his promotion to the next grade. He needs to manage himself and, as a high school student, take some responsibility for his own life...

dialogue.origin: いつも、泣きついてくるんで…
dialogue.content: He always comes crying to me...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、息子さんはお母さんをとても頼りにしておられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So your son relies on you a great deal.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです困ったらお母さんに泣きつくってのが、当たり前
dialogue.content: That's right. It's a given that if he's in trouble, he'll come crying to his mom.

dialogue.origin: では、少し自立や自己管理を覚えてもらいたいといったお気持ちと、息子さんが頼りにしてこられることは話は聞いておられてその間でしんどい思いをされていらっしゃたように感じますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, it seems like you have a desire for him to learn a little more independence and self-management, while at the same time, you listen to him when he comes to you for support. It feels like you're caught in the middle and finding it difficult. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: はいけっこう、しんどいですね　高校生になってまで…
dialogue.content: Yes, it's quite tough. Especially since he's already in high school...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね今現状で担任の先生が状況を理解してくださっていないのは、とてもお母様のご負担も大きくなっていると思います。しかしお伝えしないとお母様の負担も軽くならないと思いますので、なるべく早退のお迎えなどの負担の部分は学校にもご相談をされるとよいのかもしれません。いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. The fact that his homeroom teacher doesn't understand the situation right now must be adding to your burden. However, I think your burden won't lessen unless you communicate it, so perhaps it would be good to consult with the school about the parts that are difficult for you, like having to pick him up when he leaves early. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですねいちおう今のところ先生にも息子にも「何時にしか行けない」と言ってます
dialogue.content: Yes. For now, I’ve been telling both the teacher and my son, “I can only come at certain times.”

dialogue.origin: （もう終了時間ですね☺）
dialogue.content: (It's almost time to end, isn't it? ☺)

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたが、お話したいこお話お話できましでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Our time is up, but were you able to discuss what you wanted?

dialogue.origin: はい聞いていただけてよかったです！ありがとうございました♪
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm glad I had someone to listen to me! Thank you very much. ♪

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますでは、本日はこれで終了させていただきますまた何かあればごそうだんください
dialogue.content: Thank you. We will conclude for today. Please feel free to reach out again if anything else comes up.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました!
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: （時間すぎて申し訳ありませんでした後ほど評価を宜しくお願いいたします）
dialogue.content: (I’m sorry we ran over time. I would appreciate your evaluation later.)
